connectionSpecification.title: Azure Data Lake Destination Specification
connectionSpecification.description: Configuration for Azure Data Lake (ADLS Gen2) destination using Apache Iceberg format

azure_storage_account_name.description: The name of the Azure storage account (ADLS Gen2) that will host the Iceberg data.
azure_storage_account_name.title: Azure Storage Account Name

azure_storage_account_key.description: The shared key of the Azure storage account. Leave empty to authenticate with a SAS token, or leave all credentials empty to use the default Azure credential chain (environment variables, workload identity or managed identity — recommended when running in AKS).
azure_storage_account_key.title: Azure Storage Account Key

azure_sas_token.description: A shared access signature (SAS) token for the storage account. Only used if no account key is provided.
azure_sas_token.title: Azure SAS Token

azure_endpoint.description: Optional custom endpoint for the storage account, e.g. for a local Azurite emulator: http://localhost:10000/devstoreaccount1. If unset, https://<the storage account host in the warehouse location> is used.
azure_endpoint.title: Storage Endpoint Override (Advanced)

warehouse_location.description: The root location of the data warehouse used by the Iceberg catalog. Must use the "abfss://" scheme: "abfss://<container>@<account>.dfs.core.windows.net/<path>"
warehouse_location.title: Warehouse Location

main_branch_name.description: The primary or default branch name in the catalog. Most query engines will use "main" by default. See Iceberg documentation for more information.
main_branch_name.title: Main Branch Name

namespace.description: The default namespace to use for tables. This will ONLY be used if the `Destination Namespace` setting is set to `Destination-defined` or `Source-defined`
namespace.title: Default Namespace

oneOf.title: REST Catalog
oneOf.description: Configuration for an Iceberg REST catalog.

server_uri.description: The base URL of the Iceberg REST catalog server. For example: http://localhost:8181 or https://catalog.example.com/api/catalog
server_uri.title: REST Server URI

warehouse.description: Optional warehouse identifier to send to the REST catalog (the "warehouse" property). Some multi-catalog REST servers (e.g. Polaris, Unity Catalog, Lakekeeper) use this to select the catalog. If unset, the Warehouse Location is sent instead.
warehouse.title: Warehouse

auth_token.description: Optional static bearer token for authenticating against the REST catalog server.
auth_token.title: Bearer Token

credential.description: Optional OAuth2 client credential for the REST catalog, in the form client_id:client_secret.
credential.title: OAuth2 Credential

scope.description: Optional OAuth2 scope to request when using a credential.
scope.title: OAuth2 Scope

oauth2_server_uri.description: Optional OAuth2 token endpoint. If unset, the REST catalog server's default token endpoint is used.
oauth2_server_uri.title: OAuth2 Server URI

catalog_type.description: Specifies the type of Iceberg catalog.
catalog_type.title: Catalog Type
